purpose: User-approved before/after extraction-only check on the same full public workspaces as scientific-reading-v1. No method changes between calls; no repairs, probes, verifiers or retries.
criteria: Scientific explanations attach to relevant implementation objects, including parameters and predicates, rather than only reproduction wrappers.
Nontrivial scientific claims have supporting public sources; uncertain interpretations remain explicit.
Compare scientific content, implementation links, omissions and token costs against v1; finding function names alone is not success.
